recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Pellet Panic: Neon Maze Run` as a single-file mobile-first browser arcade game. Preserve a three-lane portrait runner loop: the player starts in the center lane, taps the left or right half of the canvas to move one lane, falling objects approach from the top, collectible pellets award +100 and disappear on contact, missed hazards grant survival score, and ghost collision triggers game over with restart. Transform presentation into a bright retro Pac-Man-inspired neon maze: a chomping yellow focal actor, colored procedural ghosts, glowing pellets, scrolling blue maze rails, Press Start arcade typography, concise mobile HUD, and escalating visual pressure without adding new mechanics such as free grid movement, power modes, or lives.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile portrait three-lane arcade runner.
- objective: Survive as long as possible while collecting rewarding pickups and avoiding falling hazards.
- input model: Tap/click left half to shift one lane left, tap/click right half to shift one lane right; keyboard arrows are safe support in the rebuild.
- core loop: Start from menu, travel forward through three vertical lanes, hazards/pickups spawn above and move downward, player changes lanes, score rises from pickups and avoided hazards, pressure escalates through speed/spawn rate.
- fail/friction state: AABB collision with any non-collectible hazard ends the run, hides HUD, shows final score, and offers restart.

## Protected mechanics
- Three discrete horizontal lane positions with bounded left/right lane movement.
- Portrait canvas playfield and mobile-first tap controls.
- Continuous requestAnimationFrame update/draw loop.
- Falling object spawn, downward travel, cleanup after passing the player, and score increments.
- Pickup collision grants +100 and removes the pickup; missed hazards grant survival score.
- Non-pickup collision triggers game-over/restart flow.
- Escalating pressure via time-based speed/spawn increase.

## Remixed target
Pellet Panic: Neon Maze Run reinterprets the lane runner as a Pac-Man-like vertical arcade maze. The player is a chomping yellow maze runner sliding between three neon corridors, pellets replace bonus coins, ghosts replace hazards, and the HUD speaks in score/pellet language. The mechanics remain the same three-lane runner loop, but the authored world, focal silhouette, maze rails, pellet feedback, ghost forms, retro typography, and portrait UI are rebuilt around mobile Pac-Man arcade tension.
